capabilities: Text.Utf8.utf8-append-rune (fresh Bytes; I32 numeric input; invalid values encode U+FFFD)
Text.Utf8.utf8-encode-into / Text.Utf8.utf8-encode-rune (I32 numeric input; invalid values encode U+FFFD; capacity refusal is atomic None)
Text.Utf8.utf8-valid-text (String valid-UTF8 invariant); arbitrary byte validation remains utf8-valid

policies: Current Unicode edition is versioned; cumulative historical Version constant records do not create obsolete table sets.
Char is scalar-only; numeric range membership includes surrogate code points.
Built-in tables and catalogs are immutable; custom metadata is checked before private owned storage is allocated.
Simple mappings preserve one scalar; no normalization, expansion or full case folding is supplied by this package.

Raw byte APIs retain malformed/non-UTF8 input; text adapters use public immutable String scalar/count observations without copying or exposing backing. The combined String direct gates are green; the full compiler/distribution chain remains pending.
Invalid decoding consumes one byte as U+FFFD; invalid numeric encoding emits U+FFFD; rune-length reports None for invalid numbers.
Append and repair outputs are unconditionally fresh; encode-into capacity refusal writes nothing.
